races.name: CAA Stellar Handicap

runners_data.name: Vintage Clarets
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but poor recent form makes him vulnerable despite Chester record
runners_data.comment: Close third in this race two years ago but has a big doubt over current form
runners_data.spotlight: Close third off 6lb higher (from stall 5) in this contest two years ago and 2-4 at Chester overall; however, has a big doubt over current form, reflected in two duck eggs this season; wide draw adds uncertainty.

runners_data.name: Jakajaro
runners_data.comment: No certainty to follow up Newmarket reappearance win; back up 5lb and has a poor draw
runners_data.spotlight: Justified favouritism at Newmarket (5f, good) on seasonal debut, belatedly recording first success since joining his current yard; useful but he's no certainty to follow up from poor draw back up 5lb.

runners_data.name: Roman Dragon
runners_data.note: Chester specialist with hold-up style perfectly suited to expected pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Seven course wins include this race last year off current mark under Oisin Murphy
runners_data.spotlight: Chester specialist whose seven course wins include this race last year (off current mark under Oisin Murphy) and Listed event later in 2025; inconsistent elsewhere since but commands respect returned to the Roodee; favourably drawn.

runners_data.name: Dubai Bling
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 35-day break with fresh legs advantage
runners_data.comment: Won his final start of a spell in Bahrain; well drawn returned to British soil; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 6f, most recently winning big-field handicap (good to firm) for a bright end to his spell in Bahrain; this local runner is well drawn returned to British soil and has possibilities provided he's as effective back at 5f.

runners_data.name: Stratusnine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping back to 5f after 6f campaigns, could benefit from pace setup
runners_data.comment: Ran well in latest AW start; record of 2212 on turf and may do better still; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Similar type to stablemate Dubai Bling, having raced mostly over 6f; beat him readily on similar terms at Wolverhampton in December and ran well at Newcastle in latest AW start; has a record of 2212 on turf and may do better still; interesting, assuming he copes with the drop in distance.

runners_data.name: Canon's House
runners_data.note: Prominent style with strong recent form and quick turnaround from Monday success
runners_data.comment: Went close at Beverley on Monday; may remain competitive, provided he takes to headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Did well last term, winning four times; back in top form, beaten only narrowly, at Beverley (5f, good to soft) on Monday with reappearance under his belt; may remain competitive off same mark, provided he takes well to first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Ruby's Profit
runners_data.note: Sole leader will get uncontested pace but may struggle against multiple late challengers
runners_data.comment: Has gained all wins in spring; finished nicely at Bath on Monday; fighting chance
runners_data.spotlight: Has gained all wins in spring, the most recent off current mark at Goodwood (5f, good) last May; finished nicely for close fourth at Bath (wore hood) on Monday with reappearance under her belt; fighting chance from a handy draw.

runners_data.name: Seven Questions
runners_data.note: Prominent runner becoming well-handicapped despite recent disappointing effort
runners_data.comment: 0-10 for current yard but he's attractively treated on best form and has the plum draw
runners_data.spotlight: Disappointing favourite at Ripon last time, taking record for current yard to 0-10, but his reappearance was encouraging and he has become very attractively handicapped; peak mark was 18lb higher and earned by bagging Group 3 honours at Newmarket two years ago; has the plum draw and can't be written off.

runners_data.name: Smart Vision
runners_data.note: Prominent style but form has dipped sharply since October double
runners_data.comment: Good spell culminated in October double; form has dipped sharply since
runners_data.spotlight: Good spell culminated in an October double; form has dipped sharply since and he is due a 2lb drop in future; close second in sole C&D attempt but this is harder and doesn't look as if he's about to add to his tally.

runners_data.name: Dapper Valley
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner with 1-length win at Salisbury just four days ago
runners_data.comment: Record of 5-7 in his races for James Owen, most recently winning on Sunday; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Registered a 1l win at Salisbury (5f, good to firm) on Sunday, taking record since rejoining James Owen to 2-2 and overall strike-rate for this stable to 5-7; those stats make him impossible to dismiss; incurs 5lb penalty in a stronger race but Christian Howarth takes off a handy 3lb.

runners_data.name: Roach Power
runners_data.note: Prominent pace but failed over 6f recently, returning to preferred 5f trip
runners_data.comment: Has a very good record at 5f but faces a harder task off current mark in this field
runners_data.spotlight: Posted duck eggs over 6f in last two appearances, not beaten entirely by the trip; has a very good record at 5f but faces a harder task off current mark at this level, especially from an unfavourable draw.

runners_data.name: Atomic Force
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but poor turf form last time after AW success
runners_data.comment: Successful in last two AW attempts; form dipped back on turf last time; opposed
runners_data.spotlight: Successful in last two AW attempts but wasn't in anything like the same form returned to turf last time (effective in this sphere in the past); remains on career-high mark and can be opposed kept to grass.

runners_data.name: Arklow Lad
runners_data.comment: Low-mileage 4yo who is 2-3 for new yard; badly drawn but otherwise a progressive contender
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who responded well to first-time cheekpieces at Pontefract (good to soft) most recently, taking record for shrewd new connections to 2-3 and strike-rate over 5f to 3-6; headgear is retained; has the worst of the draw but is otherwise a progressive contender.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit is the sole confirmed front runner and will face minimal early pressure, allowing him to dictate a measured tempo through the opening furlongs. The prominent racers like Canon's House, Dapper Valley, and Seven Questions will track within striking distance but won't apply serious pressure early. This sustainable pace will create a sprint finish from the 2f pole where horses can unleash their kick. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours prominent runners and hold-up horses who can time their challenges, while the lone leader Ruby's Profit may struggle to repel multiple challengers despite his uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack times their moves perfectly from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Canon's House and Dapper Valley can use their tactical speed from ideal positions to strike when Ruby's Profit begins to tire. Their ability to track the pace without expending energy early becomes decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the sustained pace allows closers to unleash devastating finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Roman Dragon and Dubai Bling benefit from the tempo scenario, with Roman Dragon's Chester expertise and Dubai Bling's fresh legs from the break proving crucial. Their late acceleration catches the pace-tracking horses who've done more work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Profit's energy conservation from the uncontested lead proves decisive
scenarios.body: Ruby's Profit can dictate ideal fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges, especially with his recent close fourth showing fitness. The lack of early pressure becomes his winning advantage rather than a tactical burden.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If early pace becomes stronger than expected with prominent horses pressing forward
scenarios.body: Roach Power or Smart Vision could capitalize if the tempo quickens, using their natural pace to stay closer to Ruby's Profit than expected. This faster rhythm would stretch the field and favor pure speed over tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Ruby's Profit could get too easy a lead early and have enough energy reserves to resist late challenges
Dapper Valley's quick turnaround from Sunday's Salisbury win may catch up with him in closing stages
Roman Dragon's Chester expertise and hold-up style make him dangerous if pace unfolds as expected
Seven Questions needs to bounce back from disappointing Ripon effort to justify prominent market position
Canon's House showed excellent recent form at Beverley and thrives with quick turnarounds

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Dubai Champion
runners_data.note: Hold-up style likely but unproven tactically, strong Persian Force breeding suggests quality but debuts can be tricky at Chester
runners_data.comment: 40,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; by Persian Force; well-drawn debutant
runners_data.spotlight: March foal; 38,000euros foal, 40,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Persian Force half-brother to two winners, notably Mansa Musa (5.5f/6f including 2yo/US Listed; RPR 113); dam 6f AW scorer (74); well-drawn debutant.

runners_data.name: Koodini
runners_data.note: Hold-up style expected, Hugo Palmer debut runners often need experience, unknown tactical awareness concerning
runners_data.comment: 20,000euros yearling; suitably bred, nicely drawn and looks an interesting newcomer
runners_data.spotlight: March foal; 20,000euros yearling; sibling to two winners, notably Old Chums (6f; RPR 84); dam 6f/1m scorer (including 2yo/Listed; 103), half-sister to 5f 2yo Listed winner Piece Of Paradise; suitably bred, nicely drawn and represents a locally based trainer who landed this race with a debutant last year; interesting.

runners_data.name: Andalnade
runners_data.note: Hold-up style probable, concerning that Tinkler 0 from 22 in last 14 days suggests stable not firing
runners_data.comment: 37,000gns yearling; by Showcasing; wears tongue-tie on debut; has the plum draw
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; 52,000euros foal, 37,000gns yearling; Showcasing half-sister to five winners, most notably Sacramento (Australian 9.5f/1m2f; RPR 97); dam 7f AW 2yo scorer (88); wears tongue-tie on debut; has the plum draw.

runners_data.name: Penny Capri
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with hood fitted suggesting temperament concerns, expensive breeze-up purchase indicates ability
runners_data.comment: £50,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Minzaal; wears hood on debut; check the betting
runners_data.spotlight: January foal; 32,000euros foal, 42,000gns yearling, £50,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Minzaal and first foal of 6.5f-1m winner (RPR 94); fitting of hood on debut suggests she's possibly fizzy; market may offer further guidance.

runners_data.name: Paper View
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with race experience advantage, 32 days since last run freshens him for this tactical test
runners_data.comment: May build on Bath promise, provided he's able to overcome the widest draw
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to seven winners; unable to justify favouritism but showed some promise with fourth of ten at Bath (5f, good) and ought to progress; possibilities, provided he's able to overcome the widest draw.

runners_data.name: Donegal Rose
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but form needs marking up after interference, Oisin Murphy booking significant positive
runners_data.comment: Form of her Leicester effort needs marking up as she was hampered in the closing stages
runners_data.spotlight: Closely related to a 7f AW 2yo winner; the form of her fifth of 12 at Leicester (5f, good to firm) needs marking up a tad as she was hampered in the closing stages; local runner who has Oisin Murphy on board and warrants respect with improvement on the cards.

runners_data.name: Caturra Lights
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who sets the form standard, 66-1 third at Musselburgh excellent debut form
runners_data.comment: Sets the standard, assuming the form of his 66-1 third at Musselburgh is backed up
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to a 6f winner; belied his 66-1 odds with close third of eight, faring best of the newcomers, in Musselburgh maiden (5f, good); sets the standard, assuming he can back up that form.

runners_data.name: Furturra
runners_data.note: Prominent pace-setter ran just 3 days ago, quick turnaround could impact stamina reserves late
runners_data.comment: Questionable whether he improved on Monday; vulnerable in this field
runners_data.spotlight: Not disgraced at Beverley (5f) on Monday but it's questionable whether he improved on his effort behind Caturra Lights at Musselburgh; vulnerable sort, taking on once-raced rivals and newcomers.

runners_data.name: Undercover Affair
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose Bath fourth suggests this sharper 5½f trip will suit better than previous 6f
runners_data.comment: Speedily bred; Bath effort suggests this sharper scenario will suit; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Speedily bred gelding who finished about 2l fourth of seven in Bath maiden (5.7f, firm) won by a 40-1 stablemate, shaping as if this sharper scenario will suit; in the mix, provided he can surmount wide draw.

runners_data.name: Sunrise At Dawn
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who showed late promise at Beverley, 22 days break allows for improvement
runners_data.comment: Made late gains at Beverley but may need a strong pace if again closing from rear
runners_data.spotlight: Made encouraging late gains on her way to fifth of 11 at Beverley (5f, good to soft) and may improve with the experience under her belt, albeit is perhaps going to need a strong pace if again closing from rear.

runners_data.name: Jazz Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style, Newmarket sixth may have been compromised by isolation on far side of track
runners_data.comment: Perhaps hindered ending up rather isolated in Newmarket maiden; likely to do better
runners_data.spotlight: Related to a Nunthorpe winner; perhaps hindered by ending up rather isolated towards the near side in maiden (5f, good) at Newmarket, finishing sixth of eight; this local runner is likely to do better, provided she can overcome wide draw.

races.paceDynamic: Furturra is the sole confirmed pace angle and will dictate from the front without pressure, creating a sustainable tempo over Chester's unique 5½f configuration. Paper View and Donegal Rose may track prominently but lack the aggression to challenge early fractions. The pace setup creates a tactical race where positioning matters more than raw speed, with the long home straight allowing held-up horses to mount sustained challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks, particularly those with tactical speed like Caturra Lights and Jazz Queen.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Flourish
scenarios.trigger: If Furturra maintains unchallenged lead to 2f pole creating moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows closers perfect striking position as Furturra weakens in final furlong. Jazz Queen and Caturra Lights benefit most from patient rides and strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Furturra gets soft lead and maintains stamina advantage over sprint specialists
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner exploits tactical naivety of newcomers and holds off late challengers. Paper View may track into second but lacks finishing punch to reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Paper View or Donegal Rose improve positioning and challenge Furturra earlier
scenarios.body: The early pressure creates moderate pace that suits horses racing handily rather than from extreme positions. These experienced runners benefit from race fitness over newcomers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Dubai Champion or Penny Capri show unexpected early pace or tactical awareness
scenarios.body: The debutants' superior breeding tells under these conditions with jockey tactics proving decisive. Their inexperience becomes less relevant in this tactical setup.

watchPoints.text: Furturra's stamina reserves after running just 3 days ago at Beverley - quick turnaround major concern
Dubai Champion and other newcomers' ability to handle Chester's unique bends and positioning requirements
Jazz Queen's tactical positioning given Tom Marquand may overcompensate from previous near-side isolation
Paper View's early positioning as his prominent style could pressure Furturra more than expected
Caturra Lights' market support given he clearly sets the form standard from Musselburgh debut

races.name: Boodles Raindance Dee Stakes (Listed Race) (Colts & Geldings)

runners_data.name: Golden Story
runners_data.note: Leading type returning from 195-day break for strong Burke/Lee combination, major fitness concern despite early promise
runners_data.comment: Rather pulled himself up when winning at Doncaster (1m, soft); otherwise a good prospect
runners_data.spotlight: Dante and Derby entry; by Lope De Vega out of well-bred mare whose three earlier offspring have best RPRs of 112, 103 and 112, including this one's brother the 2025 Great Voltigeur third Arabian Force; 13-8 favourite when winning a five-runner maiden at Doncaster (1m, soft) last October, leading 2f out and looking set for a wide-margin win before rather pulling himself up in the last half furlong; probably best forgiven that indiscretion first time out, in which case he's a good prospect for 1m2f+.

runners_data.name: Morshdi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest class rating who should benefit from strong early pace, Haggas in good form with 11/41 strike rate
runners_data.comment: Won second 2yo start and in clearcut style in 1m1f Listed race at Newmarket last month
runners_data.spotlight: Dante and Derby entry; brother to 1m2f and 14.5f (Group 2) winner Nakheel (RPR 110); won at York (1m, good) on his second start as 2yo and followed up in clearcut style in a seven-runner Listed race at Newmarket (1m1f, good) three weeks ago; has one of the two best chances on form and he's on his way up.

runners_data.name: Constitution River
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with proven form edge, Ryan Moore booking suggests confidence despite 257-day absence
runners_data.comment: Enthusiasm for getting on with it and twice made all over 7f as 2yo, notably in a Group 2
runners_data.spotlight: Group 1 entry at 1m, 1m2f and 1m4f; by Wootton Bassett out of unplaced sister to 1m4f/1m6f Group 1 winner Wonderful Tonight; short-headed at Newmarket before making all when odds-in in both a Galway maiden (7f, yielding) last July and five-runner Group 2 at the Curragh (7f, good) last August; both wins came with authority and the pedigree is encouraging for 1m2f; his enthusiasm for getting on with it last year raises more of a question but the 1m2f French Derby has been mentioned by his trainer as an objective.

runners_data.name: Flushing Meadows
runners_data.note: Another leader who struggled in better company last time, may find this grade more suitable but pace exposure remains
runners_data.comment: 1m2f might see him in a different light but Constitution River looks the yard first string
runners_data.spotlight: Group 1 entry at 1m, 1m2f and 1m4f, as is his stablemate Constitution River (also by Wootton Bassett); can't match his form, having won on debut but come up short in three Group 3s over 6.5f to just over 7f; joint favourite at Leopardstown (7f, good to yielding) on reappearance but slowly away and never showed with any chance; it's possible that 1m2f will see him in a different light but Constitution River looks the stable first string.

runners_data.name: Generic
runners_data.note: Prominent type who lacks the class of these rivals, Balding/Murphy team seeking improvement from maiden level
runners_data.comment: Looks promising for 1m2f but this is much more demanding than the Yarmouth novice he won
runners_data.spotlight: By Kameko out of 1m2f winner (77) with Group performers in family; led over 1f out when pipped in a Kempton maiden (1m, AW) in March but a win never seemed in doubt when he made virtually all in Yarmouth novice (1m, good) 17 days later; looks promising for 1m2f but this race is much more demanding.

runners_data.name: Shayem
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist whose running style perfectly suits the expected pace scenario, recent Lingfield run poor but forgettable
runners_data.comment: 3-4 record in Britain last season; only fifth of seven to Morshdi in a recent Listed race
runners_data.spotlight: Dante entry; progressive with 3-4 record in Britain last season, ending with a Listed win from the front at Pontefract (1m, soft); however, beaten a long way in Saudi Arabia this February and although back near his 2yo form in Listed race at Newmarket (1m1f, good; disputed lead 2f out) three weeks ago, that was good enough for only fifth of seven to Morshdi; major work to do.

races.paceDynamic: Constitution River, Flushing Meadows and Golden Story will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three capable of taking the lead in this small field. Constitution River looks the most likely to dictate from the front given his superior form level, but Golden Story returns from a 195-day break and may need to be positive early. The sustained pace will test stamina over this extended 1m2½f trip at Chester's tight track. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers who can pick up the pieces when the pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Constitution River, Flushing Meadows and Golden Story go too hard early in the small field
scenarios.body: The strong pace will find them out in the final furlong, allowing closers to pick up the pieces late. Shayem's hold-up style and Morshdi's class will prove decisive as they sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Constitution River dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Constitution River can dictate a more controlled pace from the front
scenarios.body: His superior class (RPR 123) and proven form at this trip will tell, especially with Ryan Moore's tactical skills. The Ballydoyle runner can kick clear when it matters most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Morshdi times it perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Morshdi gets the ideal stalking position behind the pace battle
scenarios.body: Tom Marquand can use his proven class advantage and recent race fitness to strike late. His prominent style allows him to avoid the pace troubles while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Golden Story returns fresh
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Story's 195-day break has recharged his batteries and he leads throughout
scenarios.body: Burke's charge could use his freshness advantage to outlast his rivals in a sustained battle. His debut win suggests he has untapped potential despite the long layoff.

watchPoints.text: Constitution River could get an easy lead if Golden Story and Flushing Meadows don't go with him early
Golden Story's fitness after 195 days off - any market support would be significant
Morshdi's ability to get the right position from his draw with multiple front runners in the field
Shayem's jumping from the gates - needs to be closer than usual in this small field to be effective
The pace battle between the three leaders in the opening two furlongs will determine the entire race shape

races.name: Ladbrokes Ormonde Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Jan Brueghel
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning after 285 days off but has Ryan Moore's tactical expertise and proven Group class

runners_data.name: Al Qareem
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent current form with five wins from nine recent starts, suited by the distance
runners_data.comment: Good strike-rate; Chester record reads 112, the final effort in this race 12 months ago
runners_data.spotlight: Justified favouritism in Listed grade at Musselburgh (1m6f, soft) on seasonal debut, making it five wins from his last nine starts and taking overall record to 13-36; Chester record reads 112, most recently running creditably in this race 12 months ago; again likely to give his running.

runners_data.name: Illinois
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner who won this race last year, questionable recent effort needs explaining
runners_data.comment: Beaten only a neck by stablemate Jan Brueghel in 2024 St Leger; won this race last year
runners_data.spotlight: Ran as if something was amiss in the Irish St Leger on last appearance; very consistent otherwise and justified favouritism in this contest (good) 12 months ago, prior to second-place finishes in two Cup races; beaten only a neck by stablemate Jan Brueghel in the 2024 St Leger; respected in rematch with that rival.

runners_data.name: Mount Atlas
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs the race to develop into a sprint finish, close second to Al Qareem last time
runners_data.comment: Ran well on reappearance but this is harder; fifth of six in this contest last year
runners_data.spotlight: Close second in Listed events at Chester (12.5f) last September and Musselburgh (1m6f) on reappearance, latter behind Al Qareem who gave 5lb and is now better off; further behind that opponent when fifth of six in this race last year; needs a personal best.

runners_data.name: Rahiebb
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent turn of foot but winless since debut, capable of place claims
runners_data.comment: Neck second in the St Leger; looks an interesting challenger to the Ballydoyle runners
runners_data.spotlight: Broadly progressive in his first season last year, despite being 0-6 after debut success; neck second to market leader and emerging star stayer Scandinavia in the St Leger (14.5f, soft) final start; threatening to land a major prize and, the way his figures are going, this 4yo season could prove fruitful; an interesting challenger to the two Ballydoyle runners in this field.

runners_data.name: Sons And Lovers
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been campaigned internationally this year, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Incurs 5lb penalty for Group 2 handicap win at Riyadh; faces a stiffer assignment
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful for current yard; has been on his travels this year, winning 1m7f handicap at Riyadh then creditable fourth over 2m at Meydan, both Group 2; however, incurs 5lb penalty and faces a stiffer assignment conceding weight all round in this field.

runners_data.name: Real Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but form has declined this year, struggling to recapture peak performances
runners_data.comment: Hasn't won since 2023 and faces a stiff task on these terms
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort this year, but still below peak form, when close fourth to Sons And Lovers in Group 2 handicap at Riyadh; failed to beat a rival on AW last time, hasn't won since 2023 and faces a much stiffer assignment on these terms.

runners_data.name: Beylerbeyi
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up horse fresh from Cesarewitch success, proven stayer but significant class drop required
runners_data.comment: Versatile and consistent handicapper but faces a difficult task upped in class
runners_data.spotlight: Versatile and consistent handicapper who landed the 2025 Cesarewitch (2m2f) in most recent turf attempt and has been placed in all AW starts (1m2f-2m) this year; however, faces a very difficult task at the weights upped in class.

races.paceDynamic: Jan Brueghel and Al Qareem will likely lead early with Illinois, Rahiebb and Real Dream tracking prominently, creating a reasonable but not excessive gallop over the extended trip. Mount Atlas, Sons And Lovers and Beylerbeyi will settle towards the rear as hold-up horses in this small field. The pace should be honest but sustainable given the distance, with the final three furlongs becoming crucial as stamina comes into play. This race shape favours prominent racers who can position close enough to strike but avoid any late tactical squeeze.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jan Brueghel and Al Qareem maintain a solid tempo from the start without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The honest pace will suit those who can travel strongly in behind and quicken, with the extended distance ensuring stamina becomes the deciding factor. This plays into the hands of horses with proven staying ability who don't need to be produced with a long sustained run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Slow Start
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too steady in the opening mile, creating a bunched field turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish over the final three furlongs, favouring horses with a strong turn of foot regardless of their preferred racing position. Late closers get their chance but prominent racers with pace remain competitive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Jan Brueghel early, creating genuine speed through the first mile
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up a perfect scenario for the hold-up horses who can finish with one sustained run. Front runners will weaken in the final furlong as the pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jan Brueghel gets an easy lead with no pressure and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: The class performer can control the race from the front and prove too strong in the closing stages. The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to save energy for a decisive late kick.

watchPoints.text: Jan Brueghel's fitness after 285 days layoff could be exposed if the pace becomes truly testing
Illinois showed concerning signs in the Irish St Leger and needs to bounce back to his consistent form
Mount Atlas requires tactical positioning from Oisin Murphy to get the right racing room in the straight
Al Qareem's recent form surge suggests he's still improving and could confirm Musselburgh superiority
The pace scenario will be crucial with only eight runners and limited natural speed in the field

races.name: Xenon Workplace Handicap

runners_data.name: Archer Royal
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer making handicap debut off top weight, needs to reproduce Group 3 form from 40 days off
runners_data.comment: Handicap debutant whose chance depends on whether he can reproduce peak effort (Group 3)
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap debutant whose chance off top weight partly depends on whether he can reproduce peak effort, namely third in 7f Group 3 at Newmarket last September, which was the second of his four outings.

runners_data.name: Moonfall
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 299-day absence and gelding operation, but solid novice form suggests ability remains
runners_data.comment: Solid novice form prior to Group 2 defeat; may still have more to offer; interesting

races.paceDynamic: Moonfall, Factual, Utmost Good Faith and Caballo Grande will ensure a strong gallop from the off, with at least three likely to contest the early lead. The sustained pace over 7½f on Chester's tight circuit will stretch stamina reserves, while six horses wanting prominent positions (adding Monarch's Gold and Strength Of Spirit) creates serious traffic concerns turning for home. This aggressive early tempo and mid-race congestion strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay wide and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners go hard early and create genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out stamina limitations while hold-up horses get perfect pace to aim at turning in. Chester's unique shape allows patient riders to swing wide and avoid the prominent traffic jam.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets loose or the pace becomes more measured than expected
scenarios.body: Factual or Moonfall could dictate terms and prove hard to peg back if allowed comfortable fractions. Their tactical speed gives them first run on the rest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but the prominent horses avoid trouble and get clear runs
scenarios.body: The middle-distance types like Strength Of Spirit can use their recent form edge to strike from ideal positions. Their stamina proves decisive in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and come back dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Even the moderate finishers get competitive as the race falls apart, creating a messy finish where any hold-up horse with stamina can pick up pieces.

races.paceDynamic: Londoner is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-horse field and should get an uncontested lead around Chester's tight turns. With most rivals preferring to sit off the pace (Jupiter Ammon, Celeborn, Harvey, Wanderlust all prominent/hold-up types), this creates a tactical scenario where the early gallop will be controlled rather than fierce. The sustainable tempo should allow hold-up horses to travel well before unleashing their finishing kicks in the straight. This race shape clearly favours horses with a strong turn of foot who can close from off the pace, particularly those drawn low who can save ground on Chester's unique circuit.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Londoner sets a steady tempo and the pace doesn't quicken until late
scenarios.body: The patient riders get perfect positioning behind the uncontested leader and unleash superior finishing speed in the final two furlongs. Hold-up specialists with class get ideal conditions to showcase their acceleration.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent runners press Londoner from the outset creating moderate early pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses sitting in second or third who can kick when the leader weakens. Those tracking the pace get first run on the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Londoner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Londoner gets completely uncontested fractions and stays strongly at this trip
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage around the home turn and holds off all challengers despite their late rallies. His recent Lingfield win suggests he has the stamina for this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is exceptionally slow with most runners still in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: A blanket finish ensues where the horse with the best finishing kick prevails regardless of early position. Raw speed over stamina becomes the deciding factor.

runners_data.name: Oratorical

runners_data.name: Mythical Bay
runners_data.note: Early leader who broke maiden on AW last time, Oisin Murphy booking suggests connections confident but 111 days off is worry
runners_data.comment: Won by a neck at 2-5 in a novice (9.4f, AW) on latest outing; gelded; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Carwyn
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse for 5lb claiming jockey, longer absence of 201 days and stable change raises questions about wellbeing

runners_data.name: Magnetude

runners_data.name: Parisian Scholar
runners_data.note: Front-runner with patchy record on good going, recent form solid but needs to handle expected pace pressure from multiple rivals

runners_data.spotlight: Often front-runner; 3-4 in handicaps last term, with first win on good to soft going but also a flop on good; back with two creditable supporting roles behind Moment Of Light in five-runner handicaps at Kempton (1m3f, AW) and it looks like he will be suited by 1m4f+; this race is more competitive, though, and he needs to find a bit extra, with cheekpieces enlisted.

races.paceDynamic: Be The Standard, Galilean Quality, Mythical Bay and Parisian Scholar will all want to go forward early, creating a strong gallop from the start. With four confirmed front-runners in a small field, the pace will be honest throughout this 1m4½f test, stretching stamina reserves. Chester's tight turns and this sustained tempo will likely see some early leaders fade in the straight. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Moment Of Light and Oratorical who can sit off the pace and deliver late kicks when the front-runners tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If all four front-runners go forward and maintain honest fractions
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field and create ideal conditions for hold-up horses to pick off tired leaders. Moment Of Light and Oratorical are perfectly positioned to capitalise on this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Galilean Quality or Be The Standard can dictate alone while others settle
scenarios.body: The controlling leader gets an easy time in front and kicks clear, while the other pace-setters cancel each other out early. Recent winner Galilean Quality has the form edge to execute this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If High Storm or Magnetude can track the leaders without getting involved in early pace battles
scenarios.body: These prominent runners avoid the pace war but stay close enough to strike when leaders weaken. High Storm's recent form and Magnetude's stamina give them the profiles to benefit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast early and all four leaders fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and even the hold-up horses struggle to make ground on a completely strung-out field. This chaotic scenario opens the door for any horse with a turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: Be The Standard faces serious fitness concerns after 215 days off and may not handle the early pace battle with fresher rivals
Multiple front-runners Galilean Quality, Mythical Bay and Parisian Scholar could engage in a pace duel that sets it up for closers
Moment Of Light sports tongue-tie and has been gelded since last turf run, suggesting trainer still trying to unlock improvement
Carwyn drops back from higher grade but 201-day absence and stable switch raises questions about his current wellbeing
High Storm represents the in-form Burke stable with solid recent form and ideal 22-day gap since last competitive effort
